objective: Find 2-3 GitHub repositories that together provide the widest reference set for professional scroll-driven / scrollytelling animation, then build one small HTML demo from the techniques found.

tooling.orx: not installed in this environment; the local-first research loop was run directly and its artefacts written here in the same evidence layout (evidence/ + run-manifest.json + sources)
tooling.github_mcp: available but returned 'Authentication Failed: Bad credentials' on every call; github MCP could not be used
fallbacks_used: unauthenticated GitHub REST API via curl (rate-limited partway through; batched and spaced)
read_file on cloned source for technique extraction
web_search for candidate discovery and license/activity cross-checks
headless Chromium via the Hermes browser tool for render verification

constraints: no new projects beyond a single small demo folder
single index.html preferred, CDN dependencies, no build system
existing projects (OpenResearch/, HyperFrames) must not be modified

outcome.verified: renders under headless Chromium; all five acts confirmed driving from scroll at 9 sampled positions
